digest.component_or_area: completion verifier context assembly and LLM gate
propositions: Completion verifier consumes 84-158 file-fetch requests per run dominated by re-fetching files already declared in ticket file_impact, causing 4-6s round-trip delays despite 67-82% overlap coverage.

Prefetch spec allows opt-in pre-population of file_impact contents into verifier context; close-path (graph=False) prefetches only the closing ticket's own file_impact while graph=True prefetches subtree union ranked by cross-descendant frequency.

Prefetched content is bundled as a byte-stable labelled section in the fenced ticket_context, rides the existing automatic message-tail cache, and is trimmed rather than overflowed when it exceeds the 30k-token aggregate budget.

Recovery successor runs receive prefetch via the shared assembled ticket_context; prefetch bytes are counted against physical_context_ceiling so oversized prefetch shrinks available context rather than raising an error.

A trusted anti-anchoring paragraph in completion_verifier.md (before the volatile marker) instructs verification against the working tree only for skeleton-marked files, eliminating the re-read penalty that initially caused 4x regression.
Live A/B on real tickets demonstrated 20-56% request reduction (f6fc 25→11, e6a0 20→14 requests) with equal verdict class and post-clamp coverage of 29-33% for close-path own file_impact.
